function sectionItemHeight(c, section): string

Defined in: website/views/project/layout.ts:26

Per-section CSS height: the FIRST media item's intrinsic ratio applied to the viewport width — min(100vw·h/w, SKELETON_ITEM_HEIGHT). Emitting the height before decode means the section never reflows when media arrives. Sections without a sized media array fall back to the fixed skeleton height. toFixed(4) keeps the calc string compact while preserving sub-pixel accuracy.
